summary: Betterware de Mexico (BeFra) filed a 6-K to announce the completion of its acquisition of 100% of Tupperware's operating assets in Latin America. The total consideration is US$250 million on a debt-free, excess-cash-free basis, comprising US$215 million in cash (debt-funded) and US$35 million in newly issued BeFra shares, with the shares subject to a nine-month lock-up. The transaction closed after receiving Mexican antitrust clearance and shareholder approval. Each brand will operate independently under BeFra's platform. Watch for integration execution and synergies across brands.
